runtime_semantics.nav_map_timing: Current source packed remains intact; only downstream wire map may reference a previously staged image.
runtime_semantics.full_packed_enginehost_equality: INTENTIONALLY_DIFFERENT_MAP on a cache hit with changed map pixels
runtime_semantics.metadata_none: Forward None unchanged. Original local deferred ON serializes zero metadata; deferred OFF ignores metadata. Remote None and zero tuple have distinct source behavior, preserved.
runtime_semantics.invalid_metadata: Observer first; original finite/layout checks precede original metadata validation. Source exception, close and fallback are preserved; no retry. Unnegotiated local path ignores metadata as source does.
runtime_semantics.observer_error: Actual _Capture.observe isolates sink exception, disables recorder once, and original inference continues once. An injected raw observe exception retains wrapper propagation and invokes original zero times.
runtime_semantics.map_lifecycle: Wrapped/unwrapped source traces identical for hit/miss/expiry/route/reset/gap/repeat/rollback/None/same-generation/stage and error scenarios.
runtime_semantics.flush_timing: Original request sent and phase_sent before flush_map, then infer_end. No claim GPU execution already began.
runtime_semantics.shared_input: Warp return is original infer image; one reservation, original prepare/output_buffer forwarded once; no new ownership operations.
runtime_semantics.transport: Regular-file POSIX AIO plus fake engine/IPC only; no physical USB/GPU/vehicle timing claim.
